scenario: Continuation grammar per LCCO.2.1 — `call` accepts trailing `on`, `timeout`, `error` clauses (each optional, multiple of any kind allowed). Pin: a `call` action carrying all three clause kinds parses and compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not observe LCCO.3's lowering to one outer rule plus three sibling rules.
rules_ds:
schema WeatherGetForecastsReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service weather.get_forecasts:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response WeatherGetForecastsReply

schema TimeOfDay scope ttl 1_min:
    state: String

rule daily_forecast:
    TimeOfDay t where t.state == "18:00"
->
    call weather.get_forecasts entity_id: "weather.home" cooldown: 23_h
        on response.code == 200:
            log info "got forecast"
        timeout 10_s:
            log info "forecast timed out"
        error:
            log info "forecast failed"
